class.name: OIDCTokenInParams
class.description: A build feature that issues a JWT for OIDC authentication when a build starts and provides it via build parameters.

function.name: oidcTokenInParams
function.description: Issue a JWT for OIDC authentication when a build starts and provide it via build parameters.

param.name: audiences
param.description: Newline-separated list of audience values for the `aud` claim in the JWT. When empty, use the default audience (== `iss` claim).

param.name: buildParam
param.description: Name of the build parameter that receives the token. Empty string disables the build parameter. The default value is `env.TEAMCITY_BUILD_OIDC_TOKEN`.

param.name: tokenLifetimeSeconds
param.description: Seconds before the token provided via build parameters expires. When this value is negative or zero, the default token lifetime is used (build timeout plus 10 minutes).

example.description: Issue a JWT for `https://oidc.example.com` using the default parameter and token lifetime
Issue a JWT for multiple audiences
Provide a JWT via custom environment variable
Set a custom token lifetime of 1 hour.
